questions.question: Sami calls Mina urgently: 'A patient has intense pain after a root canal treatment!' Mina answers:
options: Assess whether it's post-operative pain or an infection
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'You need to distinguish between common post-operative pain and an active infection.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will examine the patient.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'What are the signs of persistent infection after root canal treatment?' Mina answers:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The signs are multiple and must be correlated.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will look for all these signs.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What to do in case of a persistent apical image after treatment?' Mina answers:
options: Redo the treatment or consider apical surgery
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'A persistent image may require retreatment or apical resection.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will discuss the options with the patient.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'What is an open apex in endodontics?' Mina answers:
options: An immature or wide apex, often in young patients
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'An open apex is common in immature teeth.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will use MTA to create a barrier.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is MTA in endodontics?' Mina answers:
options: A bioceramic cement for apical repair
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'MTA is a bioceramic material for open apexes and perforations.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will train in using MTA.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage a canal with severe apical curvature?' Mina answers:
options: With flexible NiTi files and an adapted technique
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Flexible NiTi files are essential for severe curvatures.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will use NiTi files.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'When should antibiotics be prescribed in endodontics?' Mina answers:
options: In case of systemic infection (fever, cellulitis, trismus)
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Antibiotics are reserved for severe infections.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will prescribe with discernment.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'What is an intracanal dressing?' Mina answers:
options: A disinfectant product placed in the canal between sessions
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The dressing continues disinfection between sessions.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will use calcium hydroxide.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is the material of choice for an intracanal dressing?' Mina answers:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Calcium hydroxide is an excellent antiseptic.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will use calcium hydroxide.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage a tooth with a vertical root fracture?' Mina answers:
options: The prognosis is poor, often extraction
A root canal treatment can save it
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Vertical fractures have a poor prognosis.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will inform the patient of the prognosis.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is pulp revascularization?' Mina answers:
options: A technique to promote pulp regeneration in immature teeth
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Revascularization is an innovative technique for immature teeth.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will train in this technique.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'What are the signs of irreversible pulpitis?' Mina answers:
options: Spontaneous, nocturnal pain, triggered by heat
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Irreversible pulpitis manifests as spontaneous and nocturnal pain.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will recognize these signs.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is the difference between reversible and irreversible pulpitis?' Mina answers:
options: Reversible pulpitis responds to cold, irreversible is spontaneous
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Reversible pulpitis resolves with cavity treatment, irreversible requires root canal treatment.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will differentiate the two.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage a patient with an acute abscess?' Mina answers:
options: Drainage, root canal treatment or extraction, antibiotics if necessary
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'An acute abscess requires drainage and treatment of the cause.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will drain and treat.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What are the criteria for success of a root canal treatment?' Mina answers:
options: Absence of pain, radiographic healing, normal function
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Success criteria are clinical and radiographic.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will evaluate all these criteria.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'What is endodontic regeneration?' Mina answers:
options: A technique to regenerate pulp and periapical tissues
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Regeneration is a promising technique for immature teeth.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will follow the evolution of this technique.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'When should apical resection be considered?' Mina answers:
options: In case of root canal treatment failure and impossibility of retreatment
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Apical resection is an option in case of canal failure.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will refer to a surgeon.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'What are the advantages of microscopy in endodontics?' Mina answers:
options: Visualization of additional canals and calcifications
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The microscope improves visualization and treatment.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will use the microscope.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'How to manage a tooth with internal resorption?' Mina answers:
options: Root canal treatment with MTA if possible
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Internal resorption can be treated with bioceramic materials.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will treat with MTA.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'What is post-operative pain in endodontics?' Mina answers:
options: A common inflammatory pain after treatment
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Post-operative pain is common and generally benign.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will reassure patients.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'How to manage post-operative pain?' Mina answers:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Post-operative pain is managed with analgesics and anti-inflammatories.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will prescribe analgesics.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'What are the risk factors for endodontic failure?' Mina answers:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Failures are multifactorial.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will minimize these risks.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is the importance of coronal restoration in endodontics?' Mina answers:
options: Essential to protect the tooth from fracture
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Coronal restoration is crucial for tooth survival.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will always plan for a crown.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'What are the signs of a root fracture?' Mina answers:
options: Pain on percussion, mobility, radiographic image
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Root fractures present with several signs.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will look for these signs.'

questions.question: Sami, after facing complications with Mina, says: 'I am proud of our successes!' Mina concludes: 'Complications in endodontics are...'
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Complications in endodontics are the key to saving teeth.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will continue to improve.'
